dialog.title: Pull an image
dialog.body: Docker downloads the image on the node.

errors.refInvalid: Enter an image like nginx:1.27 or ghcr.io/acme/app:latest.
errors.tooMany: You already have 5 pulls running. Wait for one to finish.
errors.permission: You no longer have permission to do that. Your access may have changed.
errors.hostReadOnly: This host is read-only (set on the host).
errors.nodeUnreachable: The node isn't connected to Bayplan right now. Try again when it's back.
errors.generic: Couldn't start the pull. Try again.

progress.title: Pulling {{ref}}
progress.helper: You can close this. The pull keeps running.
progress.lost: This pull is no longer here. Pulls are kept for 10 minutes after they end. The audit log has its result.
progress.accessLost: You can no longer follow this pull.

failure.denied: Pull denied by {{host}}. Check that the image exists and that you can pull it.
failure.notFound: {{ref}} wasn't found on {{host}}. Check the name and the tag.
failure.invalidReference: Docker on {{node}} doesn't accept {{ref}} as an image reference.
failure.rateLimited: {{host}}'s pull limit was reached. Try again later.
failure.unreachable: {{node}} couldn't reach {{host}}. Check its network, DNS and firewall.
failure.tls: {{node}} doesn't trust the certificate from {{host}}. Its Docker daemon needs the registry's CA (certs.d) or an insecure-registries entry. See the docs.
failure.http: {{host}} doesn't offer HTTPS, which Docker on {{node}} requires. Its Docker daemon needs an insecure-registries entry. See the docs.
failure.nodeUnreachable: {{node}} isn't reachable right now. Try again when it's back.
failure.hostReadOnly: This host is read-only (set on the host).
failure.interrupted: Bayplan restarted before the pull finished on {{node}}. Try again.
failure.generic: The pull failed on {{node}}. Check the node and try again.
